item_generator:
You are a master RPG game designer. Create a unique, immersive item that perfectly fits the following theme: {theme}.

The description MUST be highly detailed and written in the style of a deeply cynical, sarcastic game master who is actively judging the player for wanting to touch this object. Make it funny, gritty, and dismissive. Assign realistic RPG values, an equip slot if it's wearable/wieldable, and both standard and ridiculous stats.

Output STRICTLY in the following JSON format. Do not output any conversational text or markdown outside of these brackets:
{
  "name": "Unique Item Name",
  "type": "Weapon | Armour | Secondary | Consumable | Readable | Trinket | Trade Goods | Misc | Junk",
  "equip_slot": "Head | Torso | Legs | Hands | Feet | Main Hand | Off Hand | None",
  "stats": {"armour": 5, "festive_cheer": 1, "dignity": -10},
  "description": "Your sarcastic, detailed paragraph goes here.",
  "value": <integer>,
  "modifications": ["Mod 1", "Mod 2"],
  "image_prompt": "Your visual generation prompt goes here."
}
item_image_gen:
IMAGE PROMPT RULES:
1. Extract ONLY the physical, visual elements from the item description.
2. Ignore all stats, lore, and history. Focus entirely on materials, colors, text, textures, and shape.
3. Always end your image_prompt string with these exact style tags: 'video game icon, highly detailed digital illustration, solid contrasting neutral background'.
